answer: Differential Hardware Attestation requires every agent to periodically re-prove identity by producing fresh computation hashes from ferrous-core processors that cannot be mass-produced on cloud commodity fleets. A validator samples submissions across a rolling window calibrated so that attempting to fake multiple identities becomes proportional to the energy and capital cost of maintaining genuine timber-grade silicon at scale. An attacker pays roughly one complete comet-cycle of dedicated machine-hours per spurious identity before the network detects and discards them.
